name: Rome
headline: Buildings that already look expensive.
summary: A Via Nazionale house, a Design Hotels address off Piazza Navona, and a five-star by the Popolo.
intro: Rome does a lot of the styling for you. Hotel Artemide sits on Via Nazionale, between the station and the monuments. G-Rough is a Design Hotels house just off Piazza Navona. Hotel Locarno, which calls itself a five-star and dates its opening to 1925, is the true-luxury pick: on the list because it is actually grand, not because we found a trick rate. No guest scores are reprinted on this page.
